articles.title: Cyclist critically injured in Whitby collision
articles.summary: A cyclist has life-threatening injuries following a collision in Whitby, police say. Durham police and paramedics were called to the area of Coronation Road just after 1:30 p.m. on Friday. Police say paramedics transported an adult cyclist to a trauma centre in Toronto. No further details were immediately available. Coronation is closed in both directions […]

articles.title: Businesses, officials praise success of car-free pilot project on Church Street
articles.summary: The pedestrianization pilot on Church Street is coming to an end Friday night with residents and officials raving about the boom in business and community vibes.

articles.title: Hwy. 400 speeds between Toronto and Muskoka increasing to 110 km/hr
articles.summary: Toronto-area drivers headed up north this weekend will be getting there a little bit faster. As of Friday, on Highway 400 between Highway 401 to Lake Joseph Road, the speed limit will increase to 110 kilometres an hour. articles.title: MAHA activists urge Trump against promoting coal to power energy-hungry AI data centers
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — Nearly 200 activists in Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.'s “Make America Healthy Again” movement are criticizing President Donald Trump's promotion of coal to fuel the rise of artificial intelligence data centers, according to a letter sent Friday.

articles.summary: Toronto police are looking to identify a man wanted in a criminal harassment investigation stemming from an incident in the Flemingdon Park neighbourhood on Thursday. articles.title: Ex-Abercrombie & Fitch CEO is mentally fit for sex trafficking trial, judge says
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — The former CEO of Abercrombie & Fitch is mentally competent to stand trial as he faces sex trafficking charges after being hospitalized for months for dementia and Alzheimer’s symptoms, a federal judge ruled.

articles.title: 78-year-old woman dead after highway crash in Oakville: OPP
articles.summary: A 78-year-old woman is dead after a crash in Oakville Thursday evening, provincial police say.

articles.title: Another Toronto street festival is being lost to funding shortfalls
articles.summary: The co-founder of the Yorkville Murals festival says they were denied city grants awarded in previous years. More applications are leading to more competition for funding, according to a City of Toronto spokesperson.

articles.title: Scarborough busway opening Sept. 30: TTC
articles.summary: The Scarborough busway, a dedicated transit corridor being built to replace the area's defunct Line 3 train service, is opening Sept. 30, the TTC says.

articles.title: Recently resigned Liberal MP runs for city council in Scarborough North
articles.summary: Recently resigned Liberal MP Shaun Chen is throwing his hat in for a Toronto city council position.
